content.short: Fast charting and trading interface for tokens, prediction markets, perps and sports across many chains.
content.description: Defined shows real-time charts, trades and holders for tokens on a long list of networks, including Plasma, and lets users trade from the same screen. It has expanded to prediction markets, perpetuals and sports markets in one interface, and says it takes no payment for trending placement, so its rankings come from on-chain activity. The data comes from the team behind the Codex API.
content.meta: Chart and trade tokens, perps, predictions and sports on Defined, with real-time data and no paid trending.
